traits.trampling_tolerance.note: Flora of China, Poa annua: a 'weed of disturbed ground' whose stoloniferous plants come up 'possibly in response to trampling'; Wikipedia (read 2026-11-02) adds that it makes many golf putting greens and grows on footpaths.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of China (Poa annua): annuals; culms loosely tufted, erect or oblique, often decumbent, 6-30(-45) cm; blade light to dark green, flat or folded, 2-12 cm x (0.8-)1-3.5 mm, apex acutely prow-tipped. Panicle open, broadly ovoid to pyramidal, (1-)3-10 cm, as long as wide; spikelets (3-)4-5.5 mm, florets 3-5.
